podcast.body: This 1994 album contained the song "All Over You" and, while not Grunge itself, reached the "alternative crowd" because it showed the clear influence of the Grunge era, featuring a sound that integrated alternative elements with more mainstream appeal. "Live from their 1994 album Throwing Copper and all over you."

podcast.body: This was the band's second album, released in 1994. By early May 1995, it climbed to number one on the Billboard album chart, a significant achievement for what was previously a mid-tier band. The album's success was largely driven by its hit single "Lightning Crashes." "this middling band was top of the heap."
